messages:
kevin: Heads-up — racks arrive tomorrow AM. I put together an acceptance checklist but want to confirm owners and a minimal smoke plan before we start. cc @tara @sophia

tara: Thanks. Can you paste the checklist here? I can take hardware/labelling and power checks.

kevin: Sure — core items: 1) rack labelling + U positions (tara) 2) PDUs + breaker mapping (tara) 3) network uplinks & VLANs (aj) 4) GPU firmware + driver install (sophia) 5) Kubernetes/node prep + taints (sophia) 6) throughput smoke (maria) 7) perf sanity (kevin) 8) rollback plan & staging burst slot (aj).

aj: I can own uplinks and the temporary routing to staging. Need to confirm IPs from infra team tonight. Also can provide a burst capacity token if we need to flip traffic.

sophia: For node prep I'll run the usual image build. Quick ask: what quantization/ops profile should the smoke use? small fp16 or q4_0?

kevin: Start with fp16 to validate end-to-end. Perf sanity will include q4_0 later. For smoke we mostly care about KV cache correctness and token streaming.

maria: I'll own throughput smoke. Proposed smoke steps (minimal):
```
# smoke.sh
kubectl apply -f test-deploy.yaml --namespace=staging
sleep 30
curl -N http://staging-loadbalancer/generate?prompt=hello
```
We'll run 3 parallel clients for 2 minutes and check 95th latency under 500ms.

tara: On labelling: please follow the rack tag format we used last quarter: RACK-<site>-<id>. I'll also add a sticky with owner and slack handle.

aj: IPs: using the reserved /24 10.40.77.0/24. I'll post the mapping in #eng-network in 30m. Also will do an L2 smoke after uplinks are patched.

kevin: Rollback plan: if perf or errors > 5% in smoke, we revert routing to staging-old and power-cycle GPUs to repro. Need someone on-call for firmware roll-back — @sophia?

sophia: I can handle firmware rollback if needed. Point me to the firmware bucket and the driver rollback script.

kevin: firmware bucket: s3://redwood-gpu-firmware/prod, driver rollback script: /ops/scripts/driver-rollback.sh (will paste in infra runbook).

deploy-bot: Deployment window reserved: 2026-03-18 02:00-06:00 UTC. Incident channel: #incidents.allocated-capacity.

kevin: Timeline: arrive AM, rack/power 2h, network 1.5h, node prep 3h, smoke 1h. Goal to have a soft handoff by EOD. If anything slips >2h we shift canary to next night.

maria: One risk — vendor noted two cards may be delayed by 48h if QC flags. If that happens, we lose 2 nodes. Suggest we pre-warm the burst pool Aj mentioned to keep initial throughput.

aj: Agree. I'll reserve a burst slot sized for 4 nodes and keep it until EOD tomorrow. If vendor delay triggers, we flip routing to burst and annotate the change.

tara: Logistics: I'll bring spare cables and extra PDUs. Also want someone to sign off on grounding checks — @kevin?

kevin: I'll be on-site for sign-off. Quick ownership summary: Hardware & labelling: tara; Network uplinks & burst routing: aj; Node images/firmware: sophia; Smoke tests & metrics: maria; Perf sanity + final handoff: kevin.

sophia: Can someone add the acceptance criteria to the runbook? I want explicit pass/fail: e.g., 95th latency <500ms, error-rate <1%, successful model init <30s.

kevin: Good call. Adding now: acceptance.txt in runbook repo with those thresholds and rollback steps.

maria: I'll also post the smoke harness logs to /artifacts/staging-smoke/2245678901 after run.

aj: If power-feed fails during rack install, contingency is to move install to backup feed B (breaker 2). Tara, you'll coordinate PDUs?

tara: Yep. I'll mark breaker assignments and will confirm with facilities on arrival.

kevin: Last ask — please react with :thumbsup: when you ack your ownership and can be on-call during the window. I'll compile and send an exec summary to GtM.

tara: :thumbsup:

sophia: :thumbsup:

aj: :thumbsup:

maria: :thumbsup: 

kevin: Thanks everyone. Posting final checklist + links in #eng-runtime shortly.
